info.description: Runs top to bottom: logs in as the seeded admin and the Staff dev user, then walks each controller. IDs created along the way are chained through collection variables. Set adminEmail/adminPassword/devPassword in the environment (from `dotnet user-secrets list`), never commit them.

exec: const slot = () => new Date(Date.UTC(2031 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 60), Math.floor(Math.random() * 12), 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 28), 8 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 10), Math.floor(Math.random() * 60))).toISOString();
const s = pm.response.json().find(x => x.roleName === "Staff"); if (s) pm.collectionVariables.set("roleStaffId", s.roleId);
pm.test("Move To Do -> In Progress -> 204", () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
